messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 3(18)

(18) ‘manufacturer’ means any natural or legal person who: (a) manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured, and markets those products under its name or trademark; or (b) manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation, and puts those products into service for its own use;

response.text:
manufacturer | is defined as | any natural or legal person who meets condition (a) or (b) | | ‘manufacturer’ means any natural or legal person who:
manufacturer under (a) | manufactures or has designed or manufactured | products within the scope of this Regulation | markets those products under its name or trademark | manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation or who has those products designed or manufactured, and markets those products under its name or trademark
manufacturer under (b) | manufactures | products within the scope of this Regulation | puts those products into service for its own use | manufactures products within the scope of this Regulation, and puts those products into service for its own use
